weekend_note: Forecasts disagree on Friday: Fox Weather shows a 64% rain chance for Nov 20, while WeatherBug and Weather Underground show it dry, so bring a jacket and an umbrella downtown. Saturday and Sunday look mild (mid 70s) with low rain chances. news.title: Frost advisory covers much of the Gulf Coast
news.summary: A cold front brought frost risk inland on Nov 13, with coastal areas milder and highs rebounding to the mid 60s by Sunday.

news.title: Appraiser warns of Amendment 3 homestead scams
news.summary: Scammers are posing as appraisers to get personal details. Current homestead holders who qualify do not need to reapply, officials say.

news.title: Joe Vinson unseats Ashlee Hofberger in Escambia District 4 race
news.summary: After recounts and late ballots, independent Vinson won by 19 votes, 13,096 to 13,077.

news.title: Pensacola mayor says selling some park properties is on the table
news.summary: Mayor D.C. Reeves warned the city's general fund could shrink about 30 percent because of Amendment 3 cuts.

news.title: Nationwide FAA ground stop empties lines at Pensacola airport
news.summary: The airport director said conditions were calm during the Nov 13 stop, with no safety concern.

news.title: SS United States sank upright off Destin
news.summary: The ship sank Nov 11 about 22 nautical miles southwest of Destin-Fort Walton Beach; Okaloosa officials confirmed it landed upright. The roundup also notes debris-grinding worries near Isaias cleanup sites.

news.title: Pensacola leaders weigh phased repairs for former Gibson School
news.summary: Repairs top $6.2M; a first phase of about $2.8M would weatherproof the building.
